name: VGST
full: Vision Group on Science & Technology, Govt. of Karnataka

rules.oneSchemePerCall: GRE, K-FIST L1, K-FIST L2 or ECRA

gre.name: Grants for Research Excellence (GRE)
tips: Open to regular faculty in Karnataka universities, colleges and R&D centres (science, engineering, medicine). Apply only through PPMS.
Apply to only one of the major schemes (GRE, K-FIST L1, K-FIST L2, ECRA) in a call.
Due weightage goes to government, SC/ST, minority, KKRDB and backward-taluk institutions: state yours if it applies.

ecra.name: Early Career Research Award (ECRA)
tips: A seed grant to help young researchers start research at their own institution: show what the seed money unlocks next, such as a national grant.
Apply to only one of GRE, K-FIST L1, K-FIST L2 or ECRA in a call. Check the age limit for the call year.

kfist1.name: K-FIST Level 1 (infrastructure)
tips: K-FIST supports new or upgraded facilities around a specific research theme. Show who will use each item and how many hours per week.
Equipment procured must carry a VGST label, and unspent funds can be withdrawn after a year: show a procurement plan that spends on time.

kfist2.name: K-FIST Level 2 (infrastructure)
tips: Level 2 is the larger infrastructure grant: departments with a track record of using earlier grants well are favoured.
Tie each instrument to a research theme, named users and expected publications or services.
